brand_identity.name: Fast Lane Lawn Care
brand_identity.description: A high-performance lawn care service promising fast, pristine results. Combining the trustworthiness of outdoor services with the high-octane energy of a sports/performance brand.

surface_strategies.cards: Neo-brutalist: 2px solid #0A0A0A border, flat #FFFFFF background, sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), heavy 4px/4px drop shadow on hover.
surface_strategies.header: Solid background with hard bottom border (border-b-2 border-black) to maintain the bold, structured look.
surface_strategies.dashboards: Grid borders exposed (border-collapse style) with 1px black borders separating metrics and tables.

rules: No generic 'Inter' for headings. Cabinet Grotesk ensures a punchy, athletic, modern feel.
Limit font weights to Medium (500) for body and Black (900) for headings to create extreme contrast.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous: Use p-6, p-8 for cards; py-24 for marketing sections.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_page: Asymmetric bento grids, overlapping large typography, high-contrast sections (alternating white background and pitch-black backgrounds).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_page: Dense 'Control Room' grid layout. Zero inner margin between major panels, separated by harsh 1px borders. Use h-full to stretch items.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) to match the bold/fast aesthetic. Avoid soft, pill-shaped UI.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements should have a brutalist lift: -translate-y-1, add a hard drop-shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#0A0A0A].
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-transform duration-150 ease-out.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Fast, kinetic loading bars using the primary Electric Lime (#CCFF00) color.

components.buttons: Square edges, solid colors. Primary CTA: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black border-2 border-black hover:bg-black hover:text-[#CCFF00].

booking_flow.strategy: Multi-stage wizard (Stepper). One decision per screen to maintain momentum.
booking_flow.stage_1: Date Selection: Custom Shadcn Calendar component, full width, large tap targets.
booking_flow.stage_2: Time Selection: Grid of time slots (11am - 5pm). Selectable bold blocks.
booking_flow.stage_3: Details: Shadcn Form with large input fields (h-14, text-lg).
booking_flow.stage_4: Payment: High-contrast summary card with Stripe/PayPal payment buttons.

components.quote_request: Modal or dedicated page with Shadcn Form. Must include a styled file upload area (border-dashed border-2 border-black bg-secondary) for 'Property Size/Photo Upload'.
components.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation (dark mode: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white). Main content area in Light mode for data legibility. Use Shadcn Tables with hover state highlights.

icons_and_assets.icon_style: Duotone or Bold weight. Thick, legible lines to match the typography.

hero_background.description: High-quality, vibrant green grass field, used with a dark overlay (bg-black/40) to make white and lime green text pop.

testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements, forms, and navigation links MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layouts (Bento grids, overlapping). Do not use Shadcn 'Card' for structural marketing sections.
Implement the multi-stage booking flow using a clear, stepped UI. Do not put all inputs on a single long scrollable form.
For the Admin dashboard, use Shadcn Tabs or a Sidebar layout. Keep the layout dense and highly functional.
Use standard JWT auth flows + Google OAuth buttons. Design the login/register screens with the same bold brutalist aesthetic (lime green and black).
Ensure the Quote Request form handles photo uploads visually (even if mocked in functionality).
Strictly follow the color hex codes provided. DO NOT use standard Tailwind colors (blue, teal, purple) anywhere.
